Bash(git -C "C:\\delphi\\tools\\iORM" commit -m "$\(cat <<''EOF''
Refactor DBBuilder Strategy: extract common ALTER TABLE logic

- Create TioDBBuilderStrategyWithAlterTable intermediate class
  containing ~95% of code previously in Firebird strategy
- Move sequence methods to common IioDBBuilderSqlGenerator interface
- Delete IioDBBuilderSqlGeneratorFirebird interface \(no longer needed\)
- Add IsBlobSubTypeChanged, WarningValueChanged to Strategy.Base
- Add DoBeforeGenerateDatabaseObjects hook to Strategy.Base
  with RDBMS version info in script header
- Slim TioDBBuilderStrategyFirebird to only RDBMS-specific code:
  GetInvalidTypeConversions and hook overrides
- SQLite sequence methods raise "not supported" exception
- Update package files with new unit references

This architecture prepares for easy addition of MS SQL Server
and PostgreSQL strategies in the future.
EOF
\)")
